name: orvix-copilot-chat
description: Use Orvix managed and BYOK models in GitHub Copilot Chat with your Orvix API key.

orvixCopilot.inlineSuggestions.description: Experimental. Provide ghost-text inline completions while typing, powered by the Orvix gateway with reasoning_effort none. Credentials, prompts, and document context are never logged.

orvixCopilot.inlineSuggestionsModel.description: Model id used for inline completions. orvix/deepseek-v4-pro is the only model measured to honor reasoning_effort none with zero hidden reasoning; orvix/glm-5.2 ignores the switch and is not recommended.

orvixCopilot.inlineSuggestionsChatInput.description: Also offer inline completions inside the Copilot Chat prompt box.

orvixCopilot.inlineSuggestionsDebounceMs.description: Debounce window in milliseconds between typing and an inline completion request.

orvixCopilot.inlineSuggestionsTimeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for inline completions.

orvixCopilot.inlineSuggestionsMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion.

orvixCopilot.inlineSuggestionsPrefixLine.description: Lines of document context sent before the cursor.

orvixCopilot.inlineSuggestionsSuffixChar.description: Characters of document context sent after the cursor.

enumDescriptions: Disable reasoning for the fastest response.
Use minimal reasoning for the fastest, cheapest responses.
Use less reasoning for lower latency and cost.
Balance reasoning depth, latency, and cost.
Use deeper reasoning for complex tasks.
Use extra-high reasoning for especially difficult tasks.
Use the model's maximum reasoning effort.
orvixCopilot.reasoningEffort.description: Default Orvix reasoning effort. A Copilot model-picker selection overrides this value.

orvixCopilot.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens requested from Orvix. Use 0 to reserve up to 32,768 response tokens. Positive values are capped by the model output capability and context window.

orvixCopilot.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration of a Orvix inference request in seconds.

orvixCopilot.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time without receiving streamed Orvix response data before aborting a request.

orvixCopilot.catalogCacheMinutes.description: How long the Orvix model catalog is reused before refreshing.

orvixCopilot.debugLogging.description: Log request, stream, usage, and model-discovery metadata to the Orvix output channel. Prompts and API keys are never logged.

orvixCopilot.showUsageStatusBar.description: Show Orvix credits and usage in the status bar. Click to open the usage quick pick.

apiKey.title: Orvix API Key
apiKey.description: API key for this Orvix provider entry. VS Code stores configured secrets securely.
